input.narrative: Verified the fix by tracing all affected tests through should_colorize logic. The problematic line `if os.name != "nt" and "TERM" in os.environ: return True` was unconditionally forcing colorization on non-Windows whenever TERM was set, ignoring whether the stream was actually a TTY. This caused test_mintty_not_fixed_linux tests to fail since they expected False (non-TTY stream should not be colored). Removing this line lets the code correctly fall through to the isatty() check. All other tests remain correct: dumb TERM check still works, CI fixes still work, and non-original-standard-stream paths are unaffected.
